title: Tiny Teamwork: The Last Spark
description: Escape a robot-ruled world in a solo or 2-4-player cooperative platformer. Share a room code, carry teammates, throw debris at patrol robots and save at flags across 15 city, forest and factory stages. Climb a giant Warden, flee a chainsaw through a tree maze, and break a factory above rising lava. Original anime comic panels tell the story. The hardest challenge was synchronizing shared physics, lives and boss progression across independent clients.

controls.relay: E: relay, console, memory or debris; F throws held objects
controls.replay: R or Retry stage / Replay stage (host online)
controls.leave: Settings > Leave room / Return to title; Enter after victory
controls.pause: Solo only. Online Esc releases input while the world continues.
controls.continueCampaign: N or Continue after victory (host online)
controls.climb: W/Up and S/Down at ladders; release to hold
